item: 1 FieldNode enclosure with ports and antenna
spec: FieldNode constructable core (FND-DDR-003): light grey polycarbonate enclosure 150 x 90 x 200 mm with gasketed lid, four moulded bosses inside the back wall and the maker's kit of four external lugs (IP65); bottom face drilled in two rows for two M16 glands, an M12 ePTFE vent, two M12 5-pin sensor ports and the sub-GHz whip antenna bulkhead; printed ASA internal plate 130 x 180 x 3 mm on the bosses (FieldNode BOM lines 1 to 3 and 9 to 11)
supplier: FieldNode project; enclosure from a Fibox, Hammond or Bud class maker via an electrical distributor; connectors from an industrial connector distributor
notes: Indicative; sum of the FieldNode BOM lines it replaces ($20 + $0 + $3 + $10 + $12 + $4); port A takes the sensor cable, port B and gland 2 are capped; lugs and two-row drilling from FND-DDR-003

spec: FieldNode power board (1S LiFePO4 MPPT charger with NTC lockout, protection, fuel gauge, switched rails) and STM32WL-class LoRaWAN controller (FieldNode BOM lines 7 and 8); standard 6 W charger setting; also runs the fixed-point tracker (CBC-DDR-002)
supplier: FieldNode project; ICs from an electronics distributor (DigiKey or Mouser class); module from RAKwireless or Seeed Studio

spec: 32700 LiFePO4, 3.2 V, 6 Ah (about 19 Wh), charge 0 to 45 C; holder with 5 A fuse and 10 k NTC, as FieldNode BOM line 6
supplier: Battery distributor (cell maker that publishes a datasheet)
notes: Indicative; FieldNode standard single cell (CBC-DDR-002; the second cell belongs to the ESP32-S3 fallback only)

spec: 6 W monocrystalline, 9 V class (Vmp about 9 V at 25 C), about 290 x 200 x 17 mm, aluminium frame with a flat back lip at least 12 mm wide, with 1 m lead (FieldNode BOM line 4)
notes: Indicative; FieldNode standard panel (CBC-DDR-002); bolted through its frame lip to the rail plate (CBC-DDR-003); extension lead in line 13

spec: All bolted, no welding (CBC-DDR-003): aluminium sleeve, round tube about 128 mm outside x 3 mm wall (bore at least 122 mm), 100 mm long, with three M8 stainless rivet nuts and cup-point set screws; cap disc 8 mm aluminium plate, 122 mm diameter, on four M4 countersunk radial screws; post 42.4 x 3.0 mm tube 150 mm with a 36 mm round bar plug 40 mm long in each end; four post clips cut from 50 x 50 x 5 mm angle (two lower 35 mm long, two upper 35 mm long); rail plate 290 x 150 x 3 mm at 35 degrees with two lightening windows; four M8 cross bolts
supplier: Local fabricator from aluminium stockist tube and plate
notes: Indicative material cost; fits poles with a free top only; redesigned for construction (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: Set: four 12 mm stainless worm-drive band clamps (two for the enclosure, two for the arm), each closing on a loop of about 470 mm on a 114 mm pole (about 330 mm on a 60 mm pole, 545 mm on a 140 mm pole); enclosure saddle plate 160 x 300 x 3 mm aluminium with a 100 x 150 mm window and four band slots; two bent V-saddles of 3 mm aluminium sheet (20 mm flat, two 65 mm wings at 90 degrees, 40 mm tall) on M4 countersunk screws
notes: Indicative; V-saddles seat 60 to 140 mm poles on their faces; bands pass through slots in the plate (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: 40 x 40 x 2 mm 6063 aluminium square tube about 498 mm, butted to an arm saddle plate 160 x 250 x 3 mm aluminium with four band slots, held by two angle brackets cut from 40 x 40 x 4 mm angle (40 mm long) and two M6 through-bolts with crush spacers; two bent V-saddles as line 6; plastic end cap
supplier: Local make from metal stockist tube and plate
notes: Indicative material cost; welded-or-bolted joint replaced by bolted brackets (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: 3D-printed ASA housing 110 x 90 x 70 mm with 150 x 120 mm sun hood, window ledge, four corner bosses for M3 heat-set inserts, four standoffs for the array breakout, wedge pad for the arm with two M5 heat-set inserts and an M16 gland hole in the end wall; printed ASA window frame 110 x 90 x 3 mm; tilted 7.5 degrees toward the road; embossed "COUNTS ONLY" plaque (64 x 16 mm pad, 0.8 mm relief, letters 0.4 mm) on the road-side wall, printed with the housing
supplier: Local print (ASA filament from a 3D printing supplier)
notes: Indicative material cost; UV-stable plastic; frame, wedge pad, standoffs and gland hole added for construction (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: 0.5 mm HDPE film, 100 x 80 mm, unpigmented, with four 3.5 mm holes; clamped between the housing ledge and the window frame
notes: Indicative; transmission estimated at 0.75 in CBC-CAL-001 D1 and to be measured

spec: MLX90640 class, 32 x 24 px, 110 x 75 degree lens (BAB type), on an I2C breakout; mounted with its 110 degree axis across the street
supplier: Electronics distributor or maker-board retailer (Adafruit or SparkFun class)
notes: Indicative; read over I2C by the FieldNode STM32WL (CBC-DDR-002); mmWave radar kept as the hot-climate variant (DDR-001 D2, DDR-002)

spec: M12 5-pin A-coded moulded cable, single-ended (plug one end, open wires the other), about 2 m, PUR, IP67, 6 mm; FieldNode sensor port pinout with I2C and 3.3 V (to agree with FieldNode); open end through the head's M16 gland to the array breakout
notes: Indicative; the modelled route from port A to the head gland is 1.48 m (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: Aluminium plate 150 x 200 x 2 mm with four tie slots, UV-stable print: what is counted, "No images are stored or sent; only counts leave the device", and a link to this repository; two stainless steel cable ties 8 mm wide
notes: Indicative; public notice adopted for TRL 3 (DDR-001 D7); tied to the pole through slots (CBC-DDR-003)

spec: FieldNode hardware set (standoffs, screws, wire, ferrules, two blanking plugs, desiccant) plus stainless fasteners (M4 countersunk screws for the V-saddles and cap disc; M6 bolts and nuts for the arm brackets with two crush spacers; two M5 bolts and crush spacers for the head; four M3 screws and four M3 and two M5 heat-set inserts; four M8 bolts with nyloc nuts for the post clips; eight M5 screws for the clips; four M4 bolts for the panel lip), M16 gland for the head, panel extension lead 1.5 m (2 x 0.75 mm2 UV-rated with a sealed inline connector), two stainless wire-rope safety lanyards, UV-stable cable ties and tape; calibration jumper link for the FieldNode service header
notes: Indicative; FieldNode $6 plus $14 for the mount fixings, gland, lead and lanyards; no exploded-view callout

item: 14 Plug-in connector strip and rail fuses
spec: Pluggable terminal block strip (5.08 mm pitch, plug and header, about 12 ways) on the internal plate, and two resettable fuses (about 0.5 A hold) on the switched sensor rails, as FieldNode BOM line 15
notes: Indicative; part of the FieldNode constructable core (FND-DDR-003)
